products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a not-for-profit government research lab founded in 2020. Its site describes it as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). It develops the Falcon family of generative large language models, which it describes as making advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon family includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, described as the latest additions, with Falcon-H1 built on a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture. Other models named on the site include Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon Perception for multimodal vision and language tasks, Falcon Mamba 7B, which the site calls the first open source released State Space Language Model, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, and Falcon 40B with 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, which the site calls the first home-grown open source large language model released with weights for research and commercial use. The site states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B model as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. Falcon is described as UAE-hosted, open-source under Apache 2.0, and offering Middle East data residency.

The site also describes the launch of the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models and their ecosystems, and mentions AI71, an AI company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, which issued a call for proposals for developers to build use cases with Falcon 10B. No litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records are noted for the organization.
